hook: 104 games into college football's Holy War rivalry, history finally happened.

sections.voiceover: 104 games into college football's Holy War rivalry, history finally happened.
b_roll: historic stadium graphic showing game 104 milestone

sections.voiceover: On Saturday, No. 3 Utah hosted No. 7 BYU at Rice-Eccles Stadium. Both rivals entered ranked in the top 10 for the first time. Where did No. 7 BYU lose control?
b_roll: top ten rankings matchup graphic at Rice-Eccles Stadium

sections.voiceover: However, Utah intercepted 4 passes against No. 7 BYU in the Big 12 matchup.
Offensively, Utah's Devon Dampier accounted for 4 touchdowns and 264 yards of total offense. Utah outlasted the Cougars in a 28-20 home victory. Third-ranked Utah kept its undefeated record intact.
b_roll: stat graphic showing 264 yards and 28-20 final score

sections.voiceover: The Utes sealed their historic 28-20 win in game 104.
b_roll: rivalry record card marking undefeated Utah victory
